title: Cream of Spinach Soup
description: Cream of Spinach Soup is a classic Continental soup made with fresh spinach, aromatic vegetables, and a rich blend of cream and milk. Smooth, velvety, and vibrant in color, it is an elegant starter finished with crème fraîche and crisp garnishes.

ingredients.title: For the Soup Base
items: Fresh spinach leaves (cleaned, stems trimmed) – 400 g
Leek (white part only), thinly sliced – 1 small
Vegetable stock (or light chicken stock), hot – 750 ml

ingredients.title: For Garnish
items: Crème fraîche or lightly whipped cream – 2 tbsp
Extra virgin olive oil – a drizzle

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Spinach
steps: Blanch spinach leaves for 30–40 seconds in boiling salted water.
Immediately shock in ice water to preserve the color.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Build the Flavor Base
steps: Heat butter and olive oil in a heavy-bottom saucepan over medium-low heat.
Sweat shallots, leek, garlic, and celery until soft and translucent without browning.
Add diced potato, season lightly with salt, and cook for 2–3 minutes.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Add the Stock
steps: Pour in the hot vegetable stock and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook until the potato is tender, about 12–15 minutes.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Incorporate the Spinach
steps: Add the blanched spinach to the pot.
Stir and cook for 2–3 minutes to preserve the color and freshness.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Blend
steps: Transfer the soup to a high-speed blender and blend until silky smooth.
Return the soup to the pot.
Stir in the cream and milk, then season with salt, white pepper, and a pinch of nutmeg.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Strain for Fineness
steps: Pass the soup through a fine chinois or muslin-lined sieve for a luxurious texture.

instruction.title: Step 7 – Finish & Serve
steps: Ladle the soup into pre-warmed bowls.
Swirl in crème fraîche, drizzle with olive oil, top with a Parmesan tuile or crisp croutons, and finish with microgreens.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot with crusty bread or garlic crostini.
Garnish with crème fraîche, Parmesan tuile, and microgreens.
Pair with a light white wine or sparkling water.

chefTips: Blanching the spinach before blending helps maintain its vibrant emerald color.
Replace half the cream with mascarpone or add a touch of truffle oil for a luxurious variation.
Use a high-powered blender for a smooth, velvety texture.
Strain the soup through a fine sieve for a restaurant-quality finish.
